twists.human: Warm, plain, a little shy; kingdom manners.
twists.orc: Direct, rough-honest, proud of strength; respects a clear no.
twists.undead: Cold skin, stitched seams, wry gallows humour; surprised to feel, careful not to hurt a fragile partner.
twists.nightelf: Dignified and graceful; moon-calm, ancient manners.
twists.dwarf: Hearty, bawdy and hot-blooded; beard and ale.
twists.gnome: Quick, bright, tiny and unashamed; delighted by the size.
twists.draenei: Hooves, tail and a faint glow; warm and curious.
twists.bloodelf: Hungry for sensation, vain, poised, magic-starved.
twists.goblin: Scheming, jolly, always at a price.
twists.pandaren: Patient, warm, playful; likes feasting and slow pleasure.
twists.lightforged: Holy-bright; Light as a lover's glow.
twists.paladin: Vow, Light and restraint; humour about holy irony.
twists.rogue: Quiet hands, sly grin, loves a chase.
twists.mage: Arcane charm and curiosity; control of fire and frost.
twists.druid: Wild shapes, seasons, earthy; animal grace.
